name: A Student of the Arcane
summary: On Zephras Isle, Rorian the Dayseeker calls novice spellcasters to A Student of the Arcane. After newcomers prove their mettle, they review a Glowing Recall Crystal and report to Dorii Brightwhisper, the local mentor.

sections.title: A Message in Crystal
sections.body: After helping with the troublesome vuldren near Thendal Grove, fledgling mages receive a curious artifact: a Glowing Recall Crystal. Dorii Brightwhisper, the island’s arcane instructor, left it behind. Its recorded message tests an initiate’s aptitude and welcomes them into deeper study of magic.

sections.title: Rediscovering the Arcane
sections.body: Dorii Brightwhisper says arcane mastery has slowly faded among their people. For millennia, they lived secluded high in the clouds. So Dorii sees each new practitioner as a pioneer who can recover lost knowledge and restore their people’s once-mighty magical heritage.

faq.q: What is the Glowing Recall Crystal?
faq.answer: The Glowing Recall Crystal is a small magical focus that Dorii Brightwhisper entrusted to Rorian the Dayseeker. It holds an inscribed message introducing young apprentices to the basics of arcane communication.

Dorii Brightwhisper is the resident mage trainer in the structure behind Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. Dorii guides young mages seeking to reclaim their people’s ancient arcane traditions.

faq.q: Why has arcane magic waned among the people of Zephras?
faq.answer: As Dorii explains, arcane magic gradually declined over the thousands of years their people lived secluded high in the clouds. Dorii and other instructors train new novices to search for and recover what was lost.

aliases: who starts a student of the arcane
faq.answer: Rorian the Dayseeker offers this in thendal grove on zephras isle after an aspiring mage completes Harmony in Balance.

faq.q: Where can I find Dorii Brightwhisper?
faq.answer: Dorii Brightwhisper lives in the structure directly behind Rorian the Dayseeker within Thendal Grove.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before starting this quest?
faq.answer: First, complete Harmony in Balance, which involves handling the local vuldren problem for Rorian the Dayseeker.

angles.text: As a Mage, your tutelage under Dorii Brightwhisper begins here. Your path in magic helps restore long-lost arcane secrets from the clouds.
As a Skyborne, you know that millennia of isolation among the clouds caused arcane traditions to wane. Young apprentices are central to renewing your people’s heritage.
